description: We are doing a health knower for astronauts
summary: As a 6th standard Ihave created a space app which help them to take care of their heath in the space missions. I adress this challenge because my parents are doctors and treat patients,but my objective is differet ,I want to treat the austronauts using this app when they have health issues.
details:
the app which I have created it helps the austronauts to protect them from radiation. According to the app which I have created it shows a monitor which shows amout of proton in the space craft, if the proton risk is

-between 0-20 it is normal

-between 20-45 it is elevated

-between 45-70 it is high risk

-between 70-100 it is critical

If the monitor goes above 70 then automatically the protocal list will appear. Click on the protocal if you have completed.
